description: This file defines functions and types related to handling mentions in WhatsApp messages, including building mention configurations, resolving mention targets, checking if the bot is mentioned, and debugging mention details.

methods.name: buildMentionConfig
methods.description: Constructs a MentionConfig object using the loaded configuration and optional agent ID.

methods.name: resolveMentionTargets
methods.description: Resolves mention identities and self identity from an inbound message.

methods.name: isBotMentionedFromTargets
methods.description: Determines if the bot is mentioned in a message based on mention targets and regex patterns.

methods.name: debugMention
methods.description: Provides detailed debug information about whether the bot was mentioned in a message.

methods.name: resolveOwnerList
methods.description: Resolves a list of owner identifiers allowed to mention the bot based on configuration and self E164 number.
